headline: Warden Flag Vanishes From Linn of Mercy; Stonecradle Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the Warden flag has vanished entirely from the Linn of Mercy: eleven Colonial posts now stand where a lone Warden garrison held at the morning's report, with Lathair the most contested post of the day and the war's freshest fighting logged before noon. The Dead Lands, Callahan's Gate settled once more in Colonial hands, have fallen strangely still, their heavy toll ebbed to a trickle. The Weathered Expanse keeps its grim arithmetic, Warden and Colonial losses climbing by the hour on a five-to-four map, though its base actions paused near dawn. Stonecradle now bears the sharpest casualty lists in the field, six posts Colonial to three, with World's End busiest among them. Callahans Passage grinds on under Warden colors; the Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf have cooled, and Mooring County's twelve posts lie quiet. Day 308 closes with no victor declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
